concepts.label: underlay
concepts.gloss: An underlay is the transport-network binding or path resource over which an IP/VPN service is carried.
concepts.example: Underlay U-7 is assigned beneath SVC-42 to transport that service between its New York and Frankfurt attachment points.

concepts.label: attachment
concepts.gloss: An attachment is a service-specific endpoint where an IP/VPN service connects to a site or access interface and where its VLAN encapsulation is applied.
concepts.example: att-NY-SVC42 is the New York endpoint of SVC-42 and bears C-VLAN 100.

concepts.label: rate
concepts.gloss: A rate is the committed information rate assigned to an IP/VPN service, expressing the bandwidth the service is contracted to receive.
concepts.example: SVC-42 has a CIR of 5 Gbit/s, so 5 Gbit/s is its committed service bandwidth.

concepts.label: latency
concepts.gloss: Latency is the service-level delay objective, represented by a tier that sets a maximum permitted latency for an IP/VPN service.
concepts.example: SVC-42 is assigned latency tier T2, requiring its measured delay to be no greater than 8 ms.

concepts.label: protection
concepts.gloss: Protection is the resilience requirement of an IP/VPN service, specifying the transport failures that the service must withstand while remaining available.
concepts.example: SVC-42 has protection set to “survive one path failure,” so loss of any single carrying path must not interrupt the service.

concepts.label: grade
concepts.gloss: A grade is a named service class, such as gold, silver, or bronze, assigned to categorize an IP/VPN service by its intended level of treatment.
concepts.example: SVC-42 is assigned the gold grade, distinguishing it from services classified as silver or bronze.

concepts.label: vlan
concepts.gloss: A VLAN is the customer VLAN tag used as the Layer-2 encapsulation identifier on a particular service attachment.
concepts.example: C-VLAN 100 is configured on att-NY-SVC42 to identify the customer traffic entering or leaving SVC-42 at New York.

concepts.label: service
concepts.gloss: A service is a provisioned IP/VPN connectivity offering that joins defined attachment points and is transported over an assigned underlay.
concepts.example: SVC-42 provides connectivity between att-NY-SVC42 and att-FRA-SVC42 and rides underlay U-7.
